title: Senior Web Engineer (AI Fluent), Front End Products
description: Company Description Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries. Job Description Experian Partner Solutions (EPS) is looking for Senior Web Engineers to build the products our partners white label as their own – embedded components that run inside partner applications, and turnkey hosted sites that carry a partner's brand. When a partner puts our software in front of their customers, our code runs under their brand, in their environment, with their reputation attached. There is no margin for "it works on my machine." We are looking for problem solvers first. We care much more about the depth and judgment you bring than about which specific frameworks you have used. Our stack is predominantly JavaScript and TypeScript across the browser and the server – React on the front end, Node in our services and tooling. We are building this team around AI-assisted development. That is not a perk in the job description – it is the operating model. You will spend a significant share of your time directing AI coding agents, reviewing what those agents produce, and being personally accountable for code you did not type character by character. If that sounds like a downgrade of the craft, this is the wrong role. If it sounds like the most leveraged version of the job you have ever had, keep reading. This is a senior individual contributor role. We are looking for someone with the architecture judgment to decide what to build, not just the speed to build it. Own web software end-to-end – design, build, ship, and support it in production. Ownership does not stop at the merge. Direct AI coding agents as your primary implementation method rather than hand-writing every line. Decompose features into work an agent can execute reliably, and write the prompts and specs that make that possible. Make the architecture calls AI cannot make for you: interface and API design, state and service boundaries, versioning, and backward compatibility for consumers who depend on your releases. Design for environments you do not control, whether that is a hostile host page, an unfamiliar partner configuration, or an unexpected client of your API. Use AI to generate test suites and regression coverage, then hunt what the generator missed: adversarial inputs, integration conflicts, and configuration edge cases. Assess blast radius before you merge — in a multi-tenant product, a change that is wrong for one partner is often wrong for all of them. Agentic Responsibilities: Fluent use of AI coding assistants – Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, Kiro, or equivalent – as a primary development tool. Ability to decompose a non-trivial feature into chunks an agent completes reliably. A track record of catching real bugs, security issues, and bad architectural choices in AI-generated code. Ability to explain what makes a prompt produce usable code rather than plausible-looking garbage. Use of AI to generate tests, paired with a clear view of where those tests give false confidence. Architecture and system-design judgment that weighs at least as heavily as tooling fluency. Calibrated skepticism – you can name specific things AI is bad at in your domain. Qualifications 6+ years building and shipping production web software, with real ownership of what you built after it went live. Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent experience. Strong JavaScript and TypeScript, applied across the browser and the server. We work primarily in React and Node; deep expertise in a comparable ecosystem plus evidence you pick up new stacks quickly is equally welcome. Component libraries, design systems, or SDKs consumed by teams outside your own — where breaking changes carry real cost. Server-side or full-stack web work — Node services, APIs, and the integrations that connect a customer-facing product to the systems behind it. Practical web security awareness: injection and XSS vectors, authentication and session handling, dependency risk, and safe handling of sensitive data. Experience with DevOps and CI/CD, automated test and build tooling. Additional Information Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's people first, inclusive and purpose driven culture is multi award-winning; World's Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Fortune Global Top 25), Great Place To Work™ in 26 countries to name a few. Check out Experian Life on social or explore our Careers Site to understand why. Experian is also proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity. Recruitment Fraud Awareness - Experian's recruitment process is conducted only through authorised channels. Recruitment communications will only be sent from an @experian.com email address. Experian will never ask candidates to make any payment as part of an application, interview, assessment, onboarding, or recruitment process. To apply for roles or verify opportunities, please visit experian.com/careers.
